title: PramaanScope · SIH26261
description: Evidence-led institutional review. This demonstration uses synthetic records; all issuing-source responses are simulated.

title: Each requirement has its own evidence and result
description: The matrix separates consistent content, discrepancies, unresolved verification, and human review.

title: Readable evidence can still cover the wrong campus
description: The application concerns Campus A. The submitted certificate identifies Campus B. The original and extracted passage appear together.

title: Request the specific evidence needed
description: The reviewer records a precise clarification. The finding and its original evidence remain in the review history.

title: Preview the impact before accepting a correction
description: The uploaded candidate is actually parsed. The system calculates changed fields, dependent findings, prior review actions, and unaffected findings.

title: The campus changes from B to A
description: Document-level dependencies trigger conservative recalculation. Prior source attestations are not transferred to new file bytes.

title: Accept the replacement and retain the old review
description: The original is superseded, affected checks are recalculated, and earlier reviews remain historical rather than silently becoming current.

title: An old green review cannot stand in for new evidence
description: The current campus check is consistent. Earlier review actions explicitly refer to the previous evidence version and need reconsideration.

title: A source outage is an unresolved check
description: The simulated source is unavailable. The system requests manual confirmation and does not automatically reject the institution.

title: Real OCR, processed locally
description: The bundled Tesseract model reads the synthetic scan on this device. No cloud key is required. Extraction does not establish authenticity.

title: Evidence, corrections, and reasons stay together
description: The working prototype exports a review report. Live issuer connections, signature validation, and production authentication remain pilot work.
